claims: NASA is the National Aeronautics and Space Administration.
NASA is a U.S. government agency.
NASA is responsible for civil space program.
NASA is responsible for aeronautics research.
NASA is responsible for space exploration.
NASA manages the Artemis moon program.
NASA manages International Space Station operations.
"Nasa" is a Hebrew word meaning "to lift" or "carry".
The Hebrew root verb נשא means "he lifted," "bore," "carried".
The Hebrew word can also mean "he set out" or "he journeyed" (נסע).
The Hebrew word "Nasa" is used in the context "I carried you on eagles' wings" in Exodus 19:14.
Content creators discussing Hebrew etymology explained that the Hebrew word for "deceived" (from Genesis 3) is heiani, not NASA.
National Aeronautics and Space Administration is the full title of the agency.
